# Argus Agent Test Lab

> Independent black-box adversarial testing lab for agentic payment rails — x402 payment flows, credit and settlement handling, idempotency guarantees. Every verdict is an Ed25519-signed record chained to the hash of its predecessor in a public registry that anyone can verify in one command. Seals attest run validity and findings completeness — not bug-freeness.

Working language of published artifacts: English. Motto: "We sign our findings, not our opinions."

## Verify the registry

```bash
git clone https://github.com/igor-vii/Argus-Agent-Test-Lab
cd Argus-Agent-Test-Lab
node tools/registry/verify-registry.mjs
# → registry intact: 11 records, chain head a72168544fe7bece...
```

## Verdict taxonomy

- FAIL — vendor-side failure under the probe: the SDK or platform loses money or integrity under the tested fault.
- HOLD — the SDK rejected or limited the fault; a genuine guard fired.
- PASS — the platform held beyond the documented scenarios.
- OBSERVED — observed behavior matches the vendor's published disclosure; an honest-posture result, not a defect.
- DX — developer-experience finding: no direct money-loss path, but tooling hides a hazard the runtime itself flags.

## Method (four rules)

1. Black-box by construction — the SUT is always the published artifact: npm dist, exact pin, unmodified.
2. Pre-registered before the run — required behaviors and verdict rules are fixed in committed matrix files before any probe fires.
3. Offline by default — all traffic on 127.0.0.1 against adversarial stands and honest mock backends modeled from the vendor's own contracts; no vendor-operated service touched without written authorization.
4. Sealed and hash-chained — every record is Ed25519-signed and chained to the previous record's hash; verifiable in one command.

## Engagement (B2B)

- Track A — coordinated production round: written scope, funded test wallet, 48-hour notice window, no-debit/refund arrangement, full request capture shared. Deliverable: a sealed production-round report. From $990 per round.
- Track B — fix verification: the lab's batteries become the vendor's acceptance rig; sealed PASS/FAIL per finding against the published release.
- Terms: fee agreed before any run; reports and seals remain the lab's to publish with vendor responses given equal space; private resolution welcome — the seal is a receipt, not a weapon.
